chunks: And through him, from Abdul Kareem ibn Amr, from Thabit ibn Shurayh, from Abu Baseer, who said:
I heard Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir (peace be upon him) saying: From among us there are twelve inspired ones.

key_terms.الْبَاقِرَ: The Splitter of Knowledge; title of the fifth Imam, Muhammad ibn Ali
key_terms.مُحَدَّثًا: Inspired ones; those to whom God speaks or reveals knowledge directly
key_terms.مِنَّا: From among us (the Ahl al-Bayt/Prophet's family)

ai.seo_question: Who are the twelve inspired Imams according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Imam al-Baqir (AS) identifies twelve 'muhaddathun' (those inspired by God) from the Ahl al-Bayt, a key text for establishing the doctrine of the Twelve Imams. This hadith underscores the divine selection and spiritual authority of the Imams, linking their role as inheritors of prophetic knowledge to the concept of *wahy ghayr matluw* (non-recited revelation). It serves as a foundational proof for the continuity of divine guidance through the Imams after the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (14) Abdul Kareem bin Amr narrated from Thabit bin Shurayh that Abu Baseer had said:
I have heard Abu Ja’far Muhammad bin Ali al-Baqir (as) saying: From among us there are twelve inspired ones.
